metadata.title: Exclusive | Nestle Partners With Big Tech to Boost Artificial Intelligence Use - WSJ

content.text:
Nestle NESN 0.70%increase; up pointing triangle is working with big tech companies to bolster the deployment of artificial intelligence in its factories and products as it seeks to better understand changing consumer habits.
The maker of KitKat chocolates, Nescafe coffee and Purina pet food has signed partnership deals to develop engineering products at its new facility in Orbe, Switzerland, Chief Technology Officer Stefan Palzer said. The aim is to drive growth for the business, according to the executive.
